about: Guest busy-wait loops that tools.recomp --spin-waits lowers to RECOMP_SPIN_WAIT, which sleeps instead of spinning when present.pacing = "sleep" (docs/env.md RECOMP_PRESENT_PACING). Listed sites only: a listed site that fails the matcher stops the recomp stage. analysis/recomp/spin_waits.json lists every candidate seen.

sites.note: sub_0005F960 main loop: while ([0xAE7388] < [0x3FD344]), the frame counter the vblank callback sub_000604A0 bumps in the D3D vblank DPC

D3D KickOff: while ([regs+0x100410] & 0x10000), the PFB flush bit the toolkit's ack loop clears once the walker has caught up; behind a flip hold (present-vblank-pacing) it waits up to a vblank, so it yields the guest CPU and sleeps under present.pacing=sleep

D3D KickOff in sub_002E7F30 (the push-buffer kick, the hot one: 31% of Metal stage1 CPU in the profile): the same PFB flush-bit wait as 0x002E7F20, set and polled before the put pointer write; the toolkit's ack loop clears it, so it sleeps under present.pacing=sleep like its sibling
D3D KickOff in sub_002E7FE0 (the variant without the 0x2F1B10 check): the same PFB flush-bit wait as 0x002E7F20 and 0x002E7F70, cleared by the toolkit's ack loop
